reprocess_generate_output: parse a fairseq generate.py output file into source, hypothesis, score, target, and positional score dictionaries
reprocess_nbest_interactive_output: parse a fairseq interactive.py n-best output file into source, hypothesis, score, and positional score dictionaries
write_reprocessed_hypotheses: write n-best hypotheses, sources, and targets to separate output files with optional BPE prefix truncation
parse_lm_eval_output: parse a fairseq eval_lm output file into sentences, scores, and positional scores with optional prefix length
get_score_from_pos: compute aggregated scores from positional score dictionaries using prefix length or hypothesis fraction parameters
